creators.notes: Plays with the game's own 'Show Version Info' label switched on, so the seed, build, mod count and content hash are rendered top-right for the whole run. Nothing covers that corner. The seed still has to be read off pixels at source resolution, and a reading that agrees with itself has been wrong here before: an OCR pass returned SEXT47K77REK with per-character confidence 1.0 against a true seed of SFXT47K77RFK. Verify every candidate against the Act 1 map before believing it.

occlusions: a webcam overlay sits in the top-right corner, over the region the game draws its version-info label in
creators.notes: Publishes the seed and the build as text in the video description, which is strictly better than reading either off the screen: no character recognition is involved, so the whole class of confident misreads cannot occur. The occlusion is recorded because it rules out the overlay as a fallback if a description ever omits the seed. Chapters are marked on the uploads and give the intro length and the act boundaries for free.
